description:
Kids insulated water bottle 350ml is a stainless steel vacuum flask with a flip‑straw lid, made for school bags, picnics, and travel. The cute cartoon designs (assorted Hello Kitty, My Melody, Cinnamoroll, Kuromi and Winnie the Pooh) make kids want to sip more often, while the double‑wall insulation keeps water and juice cold for up to 12 hours—great for hot school days. The one‑touch flip straw opens fast for small hands and locks shut to help prevent spills inside backpacks.

Built with 18/8 food‑grade stainless steel and BPA‑free lid materials, it keeps drinks tasting clean with no plastic smell. The wide mouth fits ice cubes and makes washing easier, and the swivel carry handle helps kids carry it confidently or hook it onto a bag. If you’re looking for a leak-resistant, easy-sip kids water bottle that stays cold and looks adorable, this 350ml insulated bottle is a smart everyday pick.
